verdict.rationale: Cactus is a local inference engine, so a one-command launcher for third-party coding agent CLIs is a fair axis, but the evidence pack never documents one. The OpenAI-compatible APIs are a developer building block, `cactus run` only runs a model, and "a coding agent with your API key" means driving the hosted platform from an agent, not launching agents against local models.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use my local models with a single command
